name: rac1/pal
about: Ratchet & Clank, PAL (SCES_509.16), rac1-decomp: tools/permuter_compile.py puts the candidate in its source file and builds it with tools/try_func.py's own build() (SN ee-gcc under Wine, the file's flags from config/file_cflags.txt, the fix-up passes); tools/try_func.py is the checker. Both run in rac1-decomp's build image, in one container kept for the run (macOS and Linux without 32-bit Wine).
start: docker start {RAC1_PERMUTER_CONTAINER} >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --init --platform linux/386 --name {RAC1_PERMUTER_CONTAINER} -v {checkout}:{checkout} -v {cache}:{cache} -w {checkout} {RAC1_BUILD_IMAGE} sleep infinity
notes: Stop the container after a session with `docker rm -f openrac-permuter-rac1`. try_func.py's EXACT, bytes masked included, is what rac1-decomp calls a match.
